title: Understanding Sui Architecture
description: Explore the unique architectural features of the Sui blockchain, including its object-centric model, Byzantine Fault Tolerance consensus, and horizontal scalability.

tasks.title: Prepare Your Exploration
tasks.description: Add at least 0.02 SUI to your wallet to prepare for technical exploration

tasks.title: Sui Design Philosophy
tasks.description: Learn about the core design principles of Sui
tasks.question: What was the primary design goal of Sui blockchain?
options: Maximum decentralization
Horizontal scalability with high throughput
Compatibility with Ethereum
Minimal energy consumption

tasks.title: Consensus Mechanism
tasks.question: What consensus mechanism does Sui use?
options: Proof of Work (PoW)
Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS)
Narwhal and Bullshark (DAG-based BFT)
Proof of Authority (PoA)

tasks.title: Object Model
tasks.question: How does Sui's object model differ from account-based models?
options: Objects can't hold state
Objects are immutable once created
Objects are owned directly rather than through global state
Objects can only represent NFTs
tasks.correctAnswer: Objects are owned directly rather than through global state

tasks.title: Transaction Types
tasks.description: Understanding different transaction types in Sui
tasks.question: What is a unique feature of Sui's transaction processing?
options: All transactions must go through full consensus
Simple transactions that don't affect shared objects can bypass consensus
All transactions must be approved by the Sui Foundation
Transactions can only be submitted through validators
tasks.correctAnswer: Simple transactions that don't affect shared objects can bypass consensus

tasks.title: Scalability Approach
tasks.question: How does Sui achieve horizontal scalability?
options: By increasing block size
Through sharding and parallel transaction processing
By limiting the number of validators
By executing all transactions sequentially but faster
tasks.correctAnswer: Through sharding and parallel transaction processing

tasks.title: Storage Model
tasks.description: Understanding how data is stored on Sui
tasks.question: What storage model does Sui use for maintaining state?
options: UTXO model like Bitcoin
Merkle Patricia Trie like Ethereum
Object-centric model with ownership
Centralized database with blockchain validation

tasks.title: Causal Order vs. Total Order
tasks.question: What ordering approach does Sui use for transactions?
options: Strict total ordering of all transactions
Random ordering for maximum efficiency
Causal ordering when possible for better performance
Time-based ordering using a global clock
tasks.correctAnswer: Causal ordering when possible for better performance

tasks.title: Gas Model
tasks.description: Learn about Sui's gas fee model
tasks.question: What unique approach does Sui take with gas fees?
options: Gas fees are fixed regardless of network congestion
Gas fees are distributed to regular users
Gas fees have a storage rebate mechanism
Gas fees are paid in a stablecoin
tasks.correctAnswer: Gas fees have a storage rebate mechanism

tasks.title: Validator Requirements
tasks.question: What is required to become a validator on Sui?
options: Own at least 1 million SUI tokens
Run specialized hardware with TPM module
Have a business license
Stake SUI and run validator software
tasks.correctAnswer: Stake SUI and run validator software
